title: A mutate_sweep mutant's anchor matches once, and the sweep's anchor pre-check reads ambiguous anchors too

note: Fix: point that mutant's anchor at stale_agent_lock_verdict; move mutate_sweep's stale-only pre-check (~1584) onto mutate_shared.find_anchor; add it to the new lint/check_mutant_anchors.py.
